chunks: "I guarantee that whoever leaves his house with his turban wrapped under his chin will return to them safely."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about leaving home with the turban wrapped under the chin?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام gives an assurance concerning one who leaves his home while wearing his turban in this particular manner. The narration indicates a protective virtue associated with this form of dress and reflects guidance connected to proper outward conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.819 - The truthful one, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"I guarantee that whoever leaves his house with his turban wrapped under his chin will return to it safely."
